schema_note: Advisory directing playbook only. Not consumed by planner, verifier, compile, master, or audit. Runtime BrandStylePolicy uses soft_priors, hard_guardrails, calibration, and provenance.

grammar_triggers.rationale: One hook option among several (see DIRECTING.md hook mechanisms): open on a straight 0-degree full-frame deep blueprint drafting grid (#14427A) with boxless editorial typography, continent silhouette cutout + T-bracket span, or clean media plate, then dive into the focal region. Prefer it only when the story's tension is a comparison of sizes or shapes.
Lock short acoustic accents directly to territory fills, text labels, metric counters, and transition cuts at 15-28 hits per minute.
Use pre-rendered 0.3-1.0s radial whip-zooms, vertical white-bar split wipes, soft dark-iris wipes, and 3D card flips for vertical regional leaps.
Sustained continuous map takes (15-60s) maintain active camera motion across >= 94% of half-second windows while cycling graphic overlays every 3-6 seconds.
Diagonal white-bordered 2- or 3-panel splits and horizontal top/bottom analogies disambiguate nested political entities and federal structures immediately.
Sweep a vertical white divider bar between satellite relief and dark monochrome vector or blueprint measurement cards to isolate border anomalies and metrics.
Stagger comparative territory fills in narration mention order using 2-3px white exterior coastline rims and terrain-preserving multiply or diagonal-hatch fills.
Pair white double-headed arrows or dashed amber lines with stacked imperial and metric values aligned to the geographic axis.
Overlay a true-scale territory silhouette onto a familiar continent or place a scaled real-world aerial anchor beside a micro-feature.

Cut via radial whip-zoom from overhead maps into flat-vector 2D cross-sections (soil layers, elevation ladders, underwater trenches, or vertical split depth comparisons) to clarify physical mechanisms.

Shift into straight 0-degree sepia parchment canvases, boxless serif era stamps directly over footage, full archival manuscript sheets, or monochrome 2D ink-sketch cutaways to separate historical eras from modern satellite geography.
Stamp a high-contrast crimson circular X over the common assumption before revealing a 3D scientific globe or geoid model.
Highlight amber initial letters during acronym expansion or display a bold amber etymology header in the upper safe band.
Anchor compact dark-and-amber population pills above vertical white coordinate pins or connect circular flag and portrait tokens with thin white leader lines.
Follow a whip-zoom dive with 3-4 concise real aerial landscape clips (0.85-2.2s each) to ground cartographic claims in real terrain.
Use left-anchored altitude or depth ticks and alternating translucent longitude columns with a single active spotlight strip.
Clip national flags cleanly inside exterior territory coastlines or attach rectangular flag markers with thin white leader lines on high-resolution ortho imagery.
Align transitions cleanly to natural narration clause boundaries under continuous narration-led pacing.
Long-form 16:9 chapter beats use compact amber #F5C542 plates with #03161F ink in the lower-third safe band.
Place boxless Archivo Black tabular metrics beside live evidence with clearance from the focal silhouette and zero dashboard card chrome.
Separate subsurface strata vertically layer-by-layer across a full-bleed dark canvas with curved white hand-drawn leader arrows rather than enclosing a small diagram inside a card.
Draw a crisp 2px white vertical or angled elbow leader line from a minimal coordinate dot directly to shadowed bold text with zero HUD box.
Place color-coded primary and secondary unit measurements side by side directly on the dark visual canvas with live tabular count-up and zero dashboard frame.
Sweep bold white display titles directly across glowing cobalt, crimson, or emerald rimmed territory highlights or use oversized lettering as a zoom-through scale portal.
Use tight 0px-radius amber/charcoal/crimson highlight tags for compact single-line map facts and curved hand-drawn white SVG arrows for place-name etymology links.
Draw an organic hand-drawn overlapping SVG Bezier oval via stroke-dashoffset directly around the focal landmass without enclosing it in a rigid rectangular box.
Use crisp T-bracket callipers on technical blueprint or map widths and expanding concentric radius rings for acoustic or geographic reach.
Pair narration of physical extremes with a boxless animated mercury thermometer or staggered SVG acoustic soundwave decibel counter directly over the map or dark footage.
Pivot between chapters with a pure alpha-gradient feathered dark curtain sweep (zero CSS blur) or circular optical spyglass iris while keeping captions crisp.

Open with a crisp 2x2 white-seamed satellite map grid showing four color-coded 45-degree diagonal-hatched territory blocks simultaneously, then expand the active pane full-screen on narration dive-in.
Switch from satellite relief to a near-black vector road basemap so luminous dual-color route networks or 45-degree diagonal-hatched urban districts with tight solid color-matched labels pop cleanly.
Render international borders, island chains, and highlighted enclaves with a three-layer luminous bloom, mid-glow, and hot white-tinted core over graded terrain.
Pair warm sepia relief cartography and an open-water vintage compass rose with a thin horizontal golden year timeline bar in the upper safe band to anchor multi-century territorial transitions.

Use the deep blueprint drafting grid for lifted relief cutouts over faint world outlines, white-bordered framed world map cards, glowing side-by-side footprint wireframes, or horizontal calibrated scale rulers.
Rotate dual-unit double-headed measurement arrows and short map annotations directly parallel to the geographic feature axis while keeping y=70% screen captions strictly horizontal.

grammar_triggers.action: director.write_story_brief(premise, central_question, tension_type, withheld_element, signature_image, register, ending_note)
grammar_triggers.rationale: Structure, hook, surfaces, colours and ending are derived from the narration's own story; a storyboard drafted without a brief drifts toward a reusable template.
Every visual must answer a stated story need for its clause; rows that could be pasted into another narration unchanged are decoration.
A line drawn on 'this line' or a focal shape that survives cuts becomes the story's anchor and can be re-purposed as the mechanism's edge or the ending callback.
Showing the viewer's own wrong intuition and physically overturning it makes the true distance or adjacency astonishing.
The contradiction is felt before it is explained when the attempted link is drawn and visibly ruptured.
A belief about a count is debunked most clearly by a counter that refuses to stop.
Defining the hook object by negation creates a question the film can hold for most of its runtime when a promise hinge grants permission to wait.
When the anomaly is too small to see, the viewer should perform the discovery through a timed scale ladder.
A mood change for the question phrase marks the turn from setup to explanation in a chapterless short.
Ordinal words in enumerated stories are chapter marks; each reason gets its own visual mode, the strongest reason the richest surface.
Seeing the effect first makes the spoken term feel like a label for something already understood.
The magnitude is read as it grows and lands exactly when the narrator says it.
Contrasting entities read faster when they receive contrasting visual treatments, not just contrasting colours.
Weather and other invisible qualities become map facts when represented by simple objects bound to the place.
Alternation over time is legible as colour when the camera holds still.
A pencil, stamp or cursor performing the verb converts a decision into a visible event.
Altitude and depth facts cannot be read top-down; a horizon view with persistent dual-unit chips makes them comparable.
The ending is chosen from the story's ending note (irony, consequence, callback, open projection, reversal, measurement, hard stop); never a default pull-back, recap, or call-to-action.

grammar_triggers.action: director.compare_fingerprint(story_shape, hook_mechanism, signature_image, surface_count, colour_cast, transition_set, ending_type)
grammar_triggers.rationale: Consecutive episodes must not share both hook mechanism and ending type, and no signature image may repeat; within a film one device never answers two different needs.
Binding each jump type (scale leap, map-to-diagram, chapter reset, archive pivot, weather, hook flip) to one device turns transitions into readable grammar.

Characters, flag avatars with faces, reaction faces, and speech bubbles turn irony into a visible beat when they perform what the narration states, stand on their own territory, and hand back to the map after one beat.
A spoken duration ('after two years', 'it took six years', 'in 30 days') becomes a large white numeral laid along the route segment it measures, so time is read as distance on the map.
A screen-constant stroke tied to the camera regime keeps the route legible on a phone at every zoom; a map-scaled hairline disappears on wide shots.
Chronological narration over a route is followed by where the drawn tip is; the tip arriving with each place name lets the map tell the story without extra labels.
Callouts placed behind the head keep the next second of route visible, and a three-callout cap keeps the route as the single dominant element.
Solver or keying noise becomes visible shake after interpolation; capped smoothing removes direction flips while keeping deliberate fast moves and story-beat framings.
Physically splitting a 10-figure silhouette row across a glowing dividing line makes asymmetric population ratios instantly legible before introducing exact headcount pills.
Popping the positive resource icon (water droplet, wheat crop) before drawing the crimson prohibition slash turns each pin into a two-beat visual argument.

grammar_triggers.action: scene.polygon(border_trace_s=0.8-2.0, border_trace_heads=2, border_trace_start=story_anchor, border_trace_hex='#F3FA23', border_trace_width=7.5, border_trace_settle_s=0.1, rim_hex='#FFFFFF', rim_width=4); fill after the trace closes (fill_alpha=0.85-0.95, fill_draw_s=0.1-0.2)
grammar_triggers.rationale: Drawing the outline from the story anchor before any colour lands tells the viewer where the territory ends; a bright constant-width head travelling at constant world speed reads as measurement, and the settle to a thin white rim hands the frame over to the fill.

grammar_triggers.action: scene.polygon(flag_fill=<code>, flag_fit='stretch' or flag_rotate_deg=90 with flag_fit='cover' for tall territories, flag_reveal='organic' (noise-edged seed from the territory centre, fill_draw_s~0.7) or 'wipe_up' (fill_draw_s~0.27), flag_wave=0.15-0.25 for a waving cloth, flag_blend='multiply' on satellite relief, rim_width=3); optionally replace the flag with the story's flat cast colour through a second layer with fill_reveal_mode='organic'
grammar_triggers.rationale: A flag clipped to the coast states ownership without a label; terrain blending keeps relief legible, and replacing the flag with a flat colour keeps the cast readable for the rest of the film.

grammar_triggers.action: scene.route(border polyline ordered north to south, color='#FDFD09', width=8, draw_duration_s=0.85-1.5, draw_ease='in_out', width_ref_zoom=<act zoom>, width_coupling=0.6) layered above both fills; a maritime continuation is dashed with round caps
grammar_triggers.rationale: A shared border is one line, so it draws with one head along the true polyline on top of both fills; width that follows the zoom with an exponent below 1 keeps the line legible through dives.

grammar_triggers.action: camera_keyframes(curve='glide' for reframes, 'snap_dive' for dives, 'hyperbolic_fly' for cross-region hops; destination key past the act end when a dive cuts at peak speed; origin key before t=0 for a snap pull-out; through=true only inside one continuous flight); optical_shutter_blur=false; bake-scene --fill-tiles
grammar_triggers.rationale: Every reframe arrives with zero velocity and no velocity corner, map frames stay sharp at every speed, and no frame is captured on upscaled tiles; speed reads from motion, not from smear.

grammar_triggers.action: clip.transition_in='disc_sweep' (feathered black disc crossing right to left over 6 frames at 30 fps); swap the register while the frame is fully black; match-frame both sides; captions stay unmasked
grammar_triggers.rationale: A match-framed sweep reads as a restyle of the same place rather than a jump to a new one.

grammar_triggers.action: outgoing act: destination camera key placed after duration_s so the dive is still accelerating at the cut, cut_blur_out_s=0.3-0.45; incoming act: cut_blur_in_s=0.3-0.45, opening already framed on the same place in the other projection; clip.transition_in='hard_cut'
grammar_triggers.rationale: Continuing the zoom across the cut hides the projection change inside motion the viewer is already following.

grammar_triggers.action: overlay(template_id='chevron_flow_band', direction='ne'|'east'|'west', chevron_count=5, corridor_label='<CORRIDOR>', speed_label='<DUAL_OR_SINGLE_SPEED>') paired with dashed route arcs along the real flow axis
grammar_triggers.rationale: Staggered directional chevrons communicate sustained atmospheric speed and flow direction without blocking terrain geography.

grammar_triggers.action: overlay(template_id='cutaway_height_gauge', title='<THRESHOLD>', reading_value='<PRIMARY_UNIT>', secondary_value='<PAIRED_UNIT>', side='right'|'left') keeping primary and secondary numerals aligned with spoken figures
grammar_triggers.rationale: A graduated vertical gauge with paired units anchors invisible height or depth limits immediately at phone scale.

grammar_triggers.action: overlay(template_id='soft_curtain_transition', mode='feathered_dark_wipe', direction='auto') spanning 3-5 frames at 30 fps while caption_rail stays above the curtain layer
grammar_triggers.rationale: A fast feathered alpha sweep covers large scale or visual-mode changes smoothly while preserving continuous caption readability.
An upright unfolding parchment folio signals a shift into historical evidence without losing typographic alignment.

exemplar_bank.notes: Moving hexagonal photo pin and tilted crimson metric badge over Europe, transitioning to a blueprint tabletop icon flip and 3D horizontal card-flip whip.
Radial whip-zoom plunge into four consecutive aerial rainforest, river-swamp, and mountain-ridge clips (0.9-2.5s each) beneath fixed plain centered captions.
Vertical white split-wipe from satellite relief to dark monochrome vector map featuring diagonal-hatched territory fills and an animated amber neighbor counter.
Unbroken 60s continuous satellite glide cycling a 20%/80% split human-icon infographic, hydro-cyan meridian divider, amber mountain mask, and drifting rain-shadow clouds.
Flat-vector 2D soil and root cross-section explaining prairie erosion, followed by a vertical dashed storm-height ruler and a tilted vintage parchment map plate.
Blueprint world dive lifting a crimson country silhouette onto Europe with perpendicular stacked dual-unit dimension brackets.
Dark air-traffic radar map with red avoidance oval transitioning to a 3D mountain altitude ladder (33,000 ft / 14,800 ft / 10,000 ft); strip external basemap attribution chrome.
Crimson terrain-preserving country fill with bold multiply title wiping into five translucent vertical cobalt time-zone columns with amber UTC offsets.
Translucent directional jet-stream chevrons comparing eastbound and westbound dashed flight arcs with duration callouts, exiting via soft dark iris wipe.
Crimson circular X myth debunk transitioning to a rotating 3D geoid globe with polar compression arrows and an exaggerated gravity model with vertical scale bar.
Glowing dashed biogeographic line with white-outlined regional fauna cutouts and stacked strait-distance brackets transitioning to a paleogeographic map and 2D underwater trench diagram.
Three-panel diagonal white-bordered split screen, amber-initial acronym expansion, dark blueprint area card, numbered vertical leaders, horizontal analogy split, and circular portrait pins.
Flat-vector underwater engineering cross-section animating deep-water bridge piers, bedrock drilling, and an amber vertical split comparing 945 m vs 75 m crossing depths.
Continuous 44.6s geopolitical map glide pairing a hand-drawn white focus lasso, circular national flag beacons, and smooth animated territorial front-line transitions.
Tilted archival decree plate transitioning into a monochrome 2D historical ink sketch, aerial agricultural ortho with amber plot square, and animated state-merger polygons.
Vertical white coordinate pin topped by a compact dark-and-amber population pill, diagonal maritime border detour, and stark crimson border stroke across ortho town imagery.
Continuous flat-map geodesic glide with dual-unit ocean measurements executing a 3D horizontal card-flip onto a spherical globe to reveal a straight great-circle path.
Tilted archival map plate transitioning to emerald-vs-cyan elevation masking, parchment historical population icons, and an amber etymology closing header.
Full-bleed 2D underground cross-section with boxless '1962' year header, direct '3,700 ac' glowing overlay, 1s field fissure clips, and a sepia street-grid depopulation graphic.
Continuous satellite cartography pairing angled elbow leader pins, tight single-line stat highlight bars, coast-to-coast city pins, and a sepia graph-grid acronym diagram with curved arrows.
Glowing horizontal latitude parallel linking crisp boxless vertical white city pins (Madrid, Paris, Toronto) followed by animated warm/cold ocean current arrows and Arctic wind ribbons.

Full-bleed dark-indigo 2D isometric cross-section separating sedimentary layers vertically to reveal an underground river with curved white arrows, followed by a clean light-neutral population choropleth.
Full-frame vintage sepia compass-grid map transitioning to a crisp circular black-masked iris aperture framing an ocean horizon.
Cohesive sepia parchment continent map using flat crimson, cobalt, teal, and amber historical empire blocks with crisp dark borders.
Minimal light-grey continental vector map hosting a vivid tornado-frequency density heatmap without card chrome, returning to continuous satellite topography.
Oversized bold white display typography zooming through into a pastel topographic vector map with nested glowing amber and cyan island-lake outlines.
Dark-canvas scientific comparison placing color-coded dual-unit temperature count-ups and a boxless '210 dB' counter with speaker glyph directly on screen—zero HUD cards or floating accent bars.
Three rapid 1.2s beats sweeping giant bold white boxless titles over glowing cobalt, crimson, and emerald island outlines with crisp white exterior rims.
Long-form 16:9 regional map opening into extreme-landscape B-roll; remap purple rims to crimson.
Long-form 16:9 numbered amber fact plate followed by 2-8 live B-roll shots and optional cartographic return.
Long-form 16:9 evidence-led tectonic climax pairing staggered plate vectors with high-resolution satellite relief.

White-bordered framed world map card with glowing red habitat perimeter over #14427A blueprint grid, diving into a vertical underwater depth cutaway (130 m to 561 m) and a horizontal calibrated blueprint height ruler (0 m / 1 m / 2 m).

Immediate map-first hook tracing a three-layer glowing amber continental border seam (5,525 mi) alternating with brisk aerial forest-corridor B-roll and a direct white double-headed 20 ft width bracket.

Near-black obsidian vector map isolating luminous coral-crimson east-west and electric-blue north-south highway corridors with numbered shields, pivoting to a warm parchment drafting grid explaining three-digit loop vs spur branches.

Glowing amber 137-island chain paired with an angled 1,600 mi T-bracket cutting into a full-bleed 2D tectonic hotspot magma-plume cross-section featuring white plume outlines and a subtle bottom-left NOT TO SCALE disclaimer.

Opens on a 2x2 white-seamed quad split of four 45-degree diagonal-hatched satellite map blocks, glides through stacked population counts (19.9M / 8.5M 42.8%), and pivots to a dark obsidian vector road map with color-matched district tags.

Lifted satellite continent cutout floating with drop shadow over faint world coastline outlines on a #14427A blueprint grid, pivoting into solid multi-bloc geopolitical fills using luminance spotlighting and crisp white internal borders.

Luminous cobalt urban enclave outline and side-by-side glowing blueprint footprint comparison (0.17 mi2 vs 0.18 mi2), transitioning to warm sepia parchment relief with compass rose, golden top year timeline bar (756-1870), and full treaty sheet.

High-resolution aerial crater view annotated with rotated white double-headed arrows and stacked metric/imperial measurements (700 m / 2300 ft, 380 m / 1250 ft, 160 m / 527 ft) aligned directly along the crater axes.
Continent-spanning road draws from frame 0, runs to the isthmus and turns red with an X before the place is named; both continents fill cyan on their own words and the middle stays unfilled.
On the spoken question the whole frame darkens with vignette and fog for the phrase, then a whip-zoom into the green polygon opens the answer.
A nine-person pictogram row and a counter racing to 80% fill while the country outline draws; the divider line draws on 'this line' and persists for the whole film.
The opening divider becomes the moisture limit: cloud sprites stall against it from both oceans, and the leeward side darkens before 'rain shadow' is spoken.
A literal pepper is dropped on the map and removed by a hand before the real country fills crimson; the elongated spoken vowel is drawn letter by letter along the coastline.
Twenty-four straight strips wipe across a tilting world, then a hard cut to a pale grey relief where one jagged border cluster is lassoed as the only colour.
On 'it was decided to change the boundaries' the camera pulls from street scale to world scale while jagged real borders draw over the straight strips.
A far-west city pin with a '10:00 am' tag while the frame progressively dims; the darkness claim is proven by grade and the film stops on the last word.
A hand-held loupe descends from the whole sea border to a one-pixel notch timed to 'closer, and even closer', then a circle highlight and question marks pop on the anomaly.
A sweeping lighthouse beam and a motion-blurred year ticker sliding across a century are the only moving elements, conveying duration without events.
A pencil enters and traces the zigzag around the lighthouse as the verb is spoken; the islet then fills in the opening's two colours to prove equal halves.
A whip-zoom turns the satellite diagram into a real aerial of the lighthouse with the same boundary overlay, ending on an irony line with no outro.
Portrait marker pops before the name, then the entire promised loop draws once while the camera pans its length before restarting at the origin year.
The film returns to the flat map and draws a dashed projection to the destination pin set by the opening vow; the journey is left open.
On a dark vector surface a large counter shows the believed two neighbours, then keeps ticking as grey ghost polygons appear.
With the camera locked on the river islet, full-frame orange and blue tint flashes land on the owning verbs to show the six-month alternation.
A glowing beam flies the long Atlantic route between two powers, then the camera whips over the pole to their true adjacency and writes the distance on the strait.
A blocky ice mask grows from the frame edges with snow particles while the border stays on top; a single walking silhouette crosses the line.

A north-south band is called a wall; concrete and steel roundels are crossed out on their words and a colour-flash cut turns the band green on 'trees'. The object is withheld as the solution for about sixty seconds.
The displaced-people pictograms that scattered earlier stream back toward the restored green belt, closing the story without words.
An unnamed zone is lassoed and filled red while aircraft icons steer around it; familiar-country silhouettes then tile the zone to count its size.
The longest reason gets the richest surface: a horizon-level terrain flight with screen-fixed dual-unit altitude chips, and an aircraft drawn under the terrain line before 'impossible' is spoken.

The route stroke widens from about 8 px on the continental leg to about 30 px in the jungle close-up and 40 px at the arrest point, then eases back to 6 px for the wide Siberian sweep; width changes ride the zoom, never a cut.
'Every 90 days' pulses rings at the exit point; the route then advances with one solid dot per forced return, each popping as the head passes it.

The two forbidden detours are hatched red and green with a white U-turn arrow; the chosen solution follows: the portrait pops at the shore, a ripple marks the entry, and white support-boat silhouettes trail the route across the water before a parallel '32 days' numeral lands.

A glowing white vertical wiper sweeps right-to-left over 260 ms to dim satellite relief to matte charcoal (#0C0E11) while keeping diagonal-hatched orange Spain isolated; a tilted amber odometer counter flies up and rolls 0 -> 1 -> 2 -> 4 -> 5 as neighbors illuminate.

On a high-zoom river island aerial with waving national flags on opposite banks, a bright warm-orange glow surges across the southern bank and island, then the glowing yellow border spline shifts to the opposite bank as an electric-blue flash surges across the northern bank and island.

An emerald-highlighted microstate displays a compact cyan population pill (80,000), which fades before a translucent cyan city silhouette slides horizontally from the left (~260 ms ease-out) directly over the country to demonstrate relative scale.

A slow aerial pull-out reveals an orange-rimmed peninsula joined to turquoise mainland by a narrow sandy neck; a luminous golden border line glows across the neck before stacked white dual-unit text ('85 m' / '(279 ft)') pops cleanly over the line.

Ten white human silhouettes pop sequentially beneath a cyan count-up to 80% as a glowing national perimeter draws on; a cyan meridian slices north-to-south while the silhouette row splits 2-vs-8 across warm-orange west and cyan east zones, followed by yellow coastal state highlights with typewriter labels and compact population pills (50M, 30M, 250M).

A gold mountain-range polygon sweeps north-to-south during an oblique bearing dive with typewriter map-plane labels; sunlit volumetric clouds with ground shadows drift from the highlighted ocean and stall against the range, then eastern clouds travel inland before tapered white wind streamlines from the gulf deflect them northward along the persistent meridian.

Warm arid-ochre shading fades across the western half while four teardrop water-drop pins pop and receive crimson prohibition slashes ~350 ms later, followed by four wheat-crop pins undergoing the same two-stage negation during a wide continental pull-out.

measured_metrics.trace_speed: constant world length per frame while the camera zooms out

exemplar_bank.notes: The border draws from the summit marker in both directions at once with round caps and no glow while the camera keeps zooming out; only after it reaches the frame edges does it cross-fade to a thin white rim, and the two country tints fade in one after the other with their names.
An accelerating zoom-out on the flat map gains radial blur, cuts at its peak to a globe of the same view, and the zoom-out continues and settles on the globe while the space background fades in.

measured_metrics.flag_fit: upright, stretched to the territory bounds

exemplar_bank.notes: During a zoom-in on the island its flag wipes in from the bottom edge, clipped to the coast and blended with the terrain, then cross-dissolves into high-resolution imagery under the next zoom so the imagery swap is never seen.

A feathered black disc crosses the frame right to left and the basemap register swaps underneath while the frame is fully black; both sides are framed identically, so the cut reads as a restyle, and the captions are never masked.

The date line draws top to bottom with its label typed along it, then the camera zooms along the line; the stroke width follows the map scale above a thin floor, so the line thickens with the zoom instead of staying a hairline.

Each country's flag, turned a quarter so its long axis follows the country, grows from a seed at the centre until it fills the coastline; the flags are then replaced by flat saturated colours by a second region growth, and only then does the shared land border draw north to south on top of both fills.

measured_metrics.dive_shape: exponential ease-in, cut at peak speed

exemplar_bank.notes: A magnifier fills the frame as the zoom accelerates into the cut; frames stay sharp at peak speed, the cut lands on a framing slightly wider than the last one, and the imagery change is covered by a five-frame dissolve into the dark plate.

A white line redraws the border from the top of the frame over the old dashed line; a red glow switches on exactly when the head enters the islet and fades after the zig-zag closes, so the glow marks the zone of interest rather than the whole line.
A rapid 4-frame right-to-left feathered alpha curtain bridges the transition between shaded-relief satellite geography and clean graphic tracks while captions remain pinned unmasked above.
Historical conservation corridor plan enters on warm sepia parchment via a top-anchored perspective unfold at 0-degree framing, giving archival context without angled HUD chrome.
Luminous directional chevron sequence sweeps along a dashed air-corridor guide to turn invisible tailwind mechanics into immediate foreground direction.
Vertical graduated ruler animates upward inside safe right margins displaying paired metric and imperial plateau ceilings synchronized with spoken elevation limits.
